title: Authority instance with a framework floor: charter.json narrows, never expands; authority.status derived
objective: Give a project instance an authority policy that is bound to the framework matrix at its pinned revision, can only add constraints, and resolves state.authority as a derived fact of a valid charter.
business_value: Without it, authority is the one thing an instance does not pin, and 'narrow, never expand' is a sentence with no artefact and no check behind it.
in_scope: charter <path> (default charter = floor, re-derives state, re-signs)
validate_charter in instance: digest binding to the pinned matrix blob; superset of roles per class, reserved actions, human-reserved roles; unknown/missing class refused; no ack path
out_of_scope: framework matrix or monotonic guard semantics
acceptance_criteria: fresh instance: authority UNRESOLVED; after charter: RESOLVED with charter path, project.yaml policy set, lock re-signed
removing a role from any class, a reserved action, or a human-reserved role is refused; BADF_AUTHORITY_DOWNGRADE_ACK does not admit it
adding a role or reserved action passes
wrong matrix digest, unknown class, missing class refused
charter present with state UNRESOLVED (re-signed) refused; charter absent with state RESOLVED refused
framework matrix moved since the pin is reported, not refused
charter writes only charter.json, state.json, project.yaml, lockfile; refuses a second charter and the framework
permissions: write: scratch repositories under the test tmpdir only

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; reconciled by the next WP's branch. Decision BADF-DEC-0006 is delegated, and says so.
